claims_reviewed.claim: A Network Finance-branded PNet advert for Senior Cost Accountant (Western Cape, ID 4285172; ref NFR011468-Sim-1) was retrievable.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Direct PNet detail page displays the title, location, Network Finance advertiser and reference; profile 51189 includes it in the 74-result Western Cape fallback snapshot.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold the existence of the agency advert only; Network Finance is the advertiser, not the identified hiring employer.

claims_reviewed.claim: The advertised role scope supports taxonomy node 9 (Management Accounting & Costing).
claims_reviewed.evidence: The advert explicitly describes a senior manufacturing Cost Accountant, costing-function ownership, standard/product costing, inventory valuation, variance analysis, FP&A and operational/commercial decision support; taxonomy node 9 is the primary remit.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold the direct-page role wording; retain the taxonomy boundary and do not infer an employer from sector/location.

claims_reviewed.claim: The direct PNet advert displays R700,000–R800,000 annually.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Direct Package & Remuneration section states R700,000–R800,000 annually. A closely matching older Network Finance ad ID 4282561 displays R600,000–R700,000 annually; likely repost/re-advertisement, not confirmed.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold the displayed annual salary evidence for economic screening; do not infer package composition.

claims_reviewed.claim: The economic R420,000 p.a. salary screen is cleared.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The stated annual lower bound/annual amount is above R420,000 p.a.: R700,000–R800,000 annually.
claims_reviewed.decision: Uphold as a salary-above-floor lead using the explicit annual figure; do not relabel as base salary or total rewards.

claims_reviewed.claim: A closely matching PNet Network Finance Senior Cost Accountant advert ID 4282561 lists R600,000–R700,000 annually and the same city, recruiter and substantially matching duties.
claims_reviewed.evidence: Direct older PNet detail page https://www.pnet.co.za/jobs--Senior-Cost-Accountant-Cape-Town-City-Bowl-Network-Finance--4282561-inline.html has ref NFR011387-Sim-1, same recruiter and similar scope; it is a likely repost/re-advertisement, not a confirmed requisition merge.
claims_reviewed.decision: Treat the pair as a probable repost/duplicate lineage and count once provisionally; preserve both source IDs and do not merge definitively without confirmation.

claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct PNet page identifies Network Finance as advertiser and uses an anonymous client/sector description; no hiring-company name is displayed.
claims_reviewed.decision: Reject any employer inference from generic sector wording, location, title, recruiter, neighbouring cards or profile branding.

claims_reviewed.claim: The employer-side requisition is confirmed to remain open.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct PNet page was retrievable and showed 10 hours ago at retrieval; no employer confirmation or closing date was displayed.
claims_reviewed.decision: Downgrade to “listed on PNet at retrieval”; employer-side acceptance remains unknown.

claims_reviewed.claim: The hiring employer is an agreed client (Boschendal Group or Laurium Capital).
claims_reviewed.evidence: No hiring-company name or agreed-client link appears in the direct advert.
claims_reviewed.decision: Do not assign an agreed-client status or promote this lead to agreed-client priority.

claims_reviewed.claim: Whether the stated annual remuneration is base salary, CTC or includes variable compensation is known.
claims_reviewed.evidence: The direct advert gives annual remuneration but does not define package composition.
claims_reviewed.decision: Retain the uncertainty; do not relabel the package as base salary.

claims_upheld: A direct PNet Network Finance listing for Senior Cost Accountant (4285172) existed at retrieval.
The direct PNet page displays R700,000–R800,000 annually.
The stated annual remuneration exceeds the R420,000 p.a. screening floor.
claims_downgraded: A live PNet page does not confirm that the end employer is still accepting applications.
Network Finance is the agency advertiser, not the identified hiring employer.
No employer identity, agreed-client status, target-company map, candidate map, employer stakeholder or company-email pattern is established.
PNet IDs 4285172 and 4282561 are a likely repost/duplicate lineage but have not been confirmed as the same requisition.
contradictions: Official Network Recruitment Finance job widget returned an error/no cards at retrieval; this is an access/rendering limitation, not evidence of no vacancies.
unknowns: The end-employer name and employer-side requisition status are unresolved.
Client/agreed-client status is unknown; no Boschendal or Laurium match is evidenced.
No employer-side stakeholder/contact or company-email intelligence can be grounded until the employer is identified.
Whether PNet IDs 4285172 and 4282561 are the same requisition/repost is not confirmed.
next_research_actions: Seek an agency-origin or employer-origin source that names the hiring employer and confirms employer-side requisition status; do not infer from sector/location wording.
Confirm package composition if material to the salary screen.
Do not begin employer stakeholder/company-email research, target-company mapping or candidate mapping until employer identity is confirmed or high-confidence.
Verify whether PNet IDs 4285172 and 4282561 are one requisition/repost; retain both pay disclosures meanwhile.
